pair_features.tm_gap_season: teammate qualifying gap %, this season to date (shrunk; + = slower)
pair_features.tm_gap_recent: teammate qualifying gap %, last 6 comparable sessions (shrunk)
pair_features.tm_gap_decay: teammate qualifying gap %, 1-year decay over 3 seasons (shrunk)
pair_features.tm_q_h2h: teammate qualifying head-to-head, decayed net rate (shrunk)
pair_features.tm_r_h2h: teammate race head-to-head, decayed net rate (shrunk)
pair_features.con_gap_pole: constructor best-qualifying gap to pole %, season to date pooled with previous season (+ = slower)
pair_features.points_before: championship points this season before the event
pair_features.champ_pos_before: championship position before the event (previous season final if no race yet)
pair_features.log_starts: log(1 + career race starts before the event)
pair_features.rookie: 1 if fewer than 10 career starts before the event
pair_features.drv_reliability: driver classification rate of started races, decayed (shrunk)
pair_features.con_reliability: constructor classification rate, season to date pooled with previous season
pair_features.race_gains: expectation-adjusted grid-to-finish gain, decayed (shrunk; expectation table built as-of)
pair_features.circ_tm_gap: teammate qualifying gap % at this circuit, prior visits (shrunk)
pair_features.circ_pctl: qualifying field percentile at this circuit minus 0.5, prior visits (shrunk)
pair_features.circ_r_h2h: teammate race head-to-head at this circuit (shrunk)
pair_features.street_driver: street event x driver street-vs-overall teammate gap
pair_features.street_con: street event x constructor street-vs-overall gap to pole
pair_features.speed_driver: high/low speed-class event x driver class-vs-overall teammate gap (as-of speed classes)
pair_features.speed_con: high/low speed-class event x constructor class-vs-overall gap to pole
pair_features.pair_q_h2h: prior qualifying head-to-head between these two drivers (decayed, shrunk) [pair-level]
pair_features.pair_r_h2h: prior race head-to-head between these two drivers (decayed, shrunk) [pair-level]
pair_features.cf_q_x_track_position: Circuit Fit component: driver qualifying pct x track-position importance
pair_features.cf_gains_x_overtaking: Circuit Fit component: race-gains pct x overtaking
pair_features.cf_street: Circuit Fit component: street form pct (street events)
pair_features.cf_driver_speed: Circuit Fit component: driver high/low-speed pct
pair_features.cf_car_speed: Circuit Fit component: car high/low-speed pct
pair_features.cf_car_qualifying: Circuit Fit component: car qualifying speed pct

target_definitions.quali_h2h: a ahead of b in the qualifying classification (all driver pairs; teammate flag marks the teammate subset)
target_definitions.race_h2h: a ahead of b in race finishing order among starters: classified position; unpositioned cars by laps completed; DSQ last; equal = void (excluded)
target_definitions.top10: started driver finishes in positions 1-10 (not disqualified)
